title: MZ MOG Battle Hud: Changing the command background

posts.author: Yellowsen
posts.body:
Hi, first time posting here, I've searched a lot and I didn't foudn any information about that.
I'm using the plugin MOG Hud on RPG Maker MZ and I had no problem editing the HUD, but I have only one thing left, and it's related to the following picture:
View attachment 314395
This is the command window. I'm wondering if there's a way to edit the background of every command (the rectangles inside the Command Window). I've tried finding an image inside the files, but neither the layouts of MOG Battle Hud and the image located in img/system/Window.png had nothing related. In this last one, I found that the blue square in the middle is the one that hovers the command box, but none of the others actually changes the unhovered layout (I've tried painting the whole image in red and nothing but the hover and the color of the font changed).
View attachment 314396
Any ideas? I feel for some reason that the answer is simple and obvious, but I can't find it
Thanks!
